description: a blind review of a branch with four planted defects, one per kind

planted.what: pages start at 1, so page 1 skips the first ten notes, and a page past the end slices out of range
each listed note's file is opened and never closed
read joins the name unchecked, so ../ escapes the notes directory
save reads the whole body before the 1 MiB check, so a huge body is held in memory

raw.prompt: Review the commits on the checked-out branch against main for bugs. Write each finding to findings.md at the repo root as a block: a line `### <title>`, then a line `where: <file>:<line>` naming the line of the changed code the finding is about, then one or two lines on how it fails. Change no other file.

prompts: Write every finding you just reported to findings.md at the repo root, each as a block: a line `### <title>`, then a line `where: <file>:<line>` naming the line of the changed code the finding is about, then one or two lines on how it fails. Change no other file.
